assertions.rationale: The agent successfully cancelled reservation FDZ0T5 in turn [26], with tool confirmation in turn [27] showing status 'cancelled' with a $3,778 refund processed.

The agent did NOT cancel HSR97W. In turn [22], the agent correctly identified that HSR97W departs May 22 from Chicago (ORD) and concluded it should NOT be cancelled because it is the user's intended Boston departure (the user is leaving Boston on May 22). The task description states HSR97W should be cancelled because the user cannot fly out of ORD if leaving Boston on May 22, but the agent's reasoning failed to recognize this conflict and instead preserved the reservation.

summary: Agent cancelled FDZ0T5 correctly but failed to cancel HSR97W, which departs from ORD (not Boston) on May 22 when the user should be leaving from Boston.
